source_caption:
One of the most underrated movies of last decade! 

The Nice Guys (2016) is set in 1970s Los Angeles and follows an unlikely duo, a down on his luck private investigator and a tough enforcer, who end up working together to look into the disappearance of a teenage girl. Directed by Shane Black, who co wrote the script with Anthony Bagarozzi, the film mixes crime with a messy, offbeat kind of humor that lets the characters take the lead.

Russell Crowe and Ryan Gosling have great chemistry, with Gosling especially standing out thanks to his awkward, clumsy charm. The story stays unpredictable and fun the whole way through, never taking itself too seriously.

source_details.synopsis: The Nice Guys is a 2016 American neo-noir buddy action comedy film directed by Shane Black, who co-wrote the screenplay with Anthony Bagarozzi, produced by Joel Silver, and starring Russell Crowe and Ryan Gosling in the title roles, with Angourie Rice, Matt Bomer, Margaret Qualley, Keith David, and Kim Basinger appearing in supporting roles. Set in 1970s Los Angeles, the film focuses on private eye Holland March (Gosling) and enforcer for hire Jackson Healy (Crowe) who team up to investigate the disappearance of a teenage girl (Qualley).
